vocabulary.meaning_en: the ability to keep things in your mind; something you remember
vocabulary.example: I have happy memories of my school.

vocabulary.meaning_ar: بادئة بمعنى مرة أخرى أو عودة

vocabulary.meaning_en: to actively search your memory for stored information
vocabulary.note_ar: أنت من يبحث بنشاط في ذاكرتك
vocabulary.example: Do you recall where I left the file?

vocabulary.meaning_en: (something or someone outside) to make you remember
vocabulary.note_en: remind someone of / about something; remind someone to do
vocabulary.example: This photo reminds me of my childhood.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have something in your memory, ready to use
vocabulary.example: I remember my first teacher's name.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to not forget to do something you need or promised to do
vocabulary.note_ar: remember + to + فعل = تذكّر أن تفعل (واجب)
vocabulary.note_en: remember + to + verb = an action you must do
vocabulary.example: Remember to close the door before you leave.

vocabulary.meaning_en: shared by two or more people or things
vocabulary.example: These three words have something in common.
Old photos are stored in the box.

fine_lines.title: recall vs remind vs remember
fine_lines.explanation_ar: recall: أنت تبحث بجهد في ذاكرتك عن معلومة قديمة. remind: شيء أو شخص من الخارج يُعيد الذكرى إلى ذهنك. remember: المعلومة جاهزة في ذاكرتك دون جهد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Recall: you actively search your memory. Remind: something outside brings the memory back. Remember: the memory is already there, ready to use.

examples.sentence: I'm trying to recall his phone number.
Please remind me to buy bread.

fine_lines.title: remember vs remember to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: remember وحدها تعني الذاكرة فقط. remember to + فعل تعني لا تنسَ أن تقوم بعمل واجب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Remember" alone is about memory. "Remember to + verb" means don't forget to do something you must do.

examples.sentence: I remember that day very well.

fine_lines.title: remind vs remember
fine_lines.explanation_ar: لا تقل Remember me to call (بمعنى ذكّرني). الصحيح: Remind me to call. فـ remind يحتاج شخصًا يُذكَّر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Don't say "Remember me to call". Say "Remind me to call". Remind needs a person: remind someone.

examples.sentence: Can you remind me to send the email?
I'll remember to send the email.

expressions.example: Do you recall what time he arrived?

expressions.meaning_en: It brings back a memory of...
expressions.example: This smell reminds me of my grandmother's kitchen.
Need I remind you that the test is tomorrow?
Don't worry, I can do it. This isn't my first rodeo.

grammar.title: remind + person + of / about / to
grammar.explanation_ar: remind يحتاج مفعولًا (شخصًا): remind someone of something (يذكّره بشيء يشبهه)، remind someone about something (يذكّره بأمر يجب ألا ينساه)، remind someone to do something (يذكّره أن يفعل).
grammar.explanation_en: Remind needs a person: remind someone of something (it brings back a memory), remind someone about something (a thing not to forget), remind someone to do something.
examples: You remind me of my brother.
Please remind me about the meeting.
She reminded me to lock the door.

questions.question: "This photo ___ me of my childhood."
questions.explanation_ar: remind someone of = يذكّر شخصًا بـ.

questions.question: Which word means you ACTIVELY search your memory?
"___ to close the door before you leave."
questions.explanation_ar: Remember to + فعل = لا تنسَ أن تفعل.
questions.explanation_en: Remember to + verb = don't forget to do.

questions.question: "Can you ___ me to buy bread?"
questions.explanation_ar: نقول remind someone to do something أي يذكّر شخصًا أن يفعل شيئًا.

questions.question: Which is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: الصحيح Remind me to call him.
questions.explanation_en: Correct: Remind me to call him.

questions.question: In court: "Do you ___ the night of July 17th?"
questions.explanation_ar: recall شائعة في المحاكم للبحث في الذاكرة.

questions.question: Your own name is always ready in your memory. You ___ it.
questions.explanation_en: Remember = ready to use, no effort.

questions.question: "Remember to" adds the idea of ___.
questions.explanation_ar: remember to تعني واجبًا يجب فعله.
questions.explanation_en: It adds something you must do.
